items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I met Helen Humes in New York City with Count Basie.

ctx.x: Was Helen Humes on that show?
I met Helen Humes in New York City with Count Basie. She used to sing with Count Basie, an' uh, she...I hadn't seen her in a long time.

So we went down to New Orleans...lately...here lately, and she done a show in one of the big hotels down there. We had Count Basie. He had a host of other blues singers--people I had never heard of. And they had...whaternam?

items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: And everybody said, Joe told everybody and people started clapping about something but I didn't know what Joe said. And he said, he was telling them that you was back there.

ctx.x: Oh, the piano player. Oh, of course. And she used to work with him?
